items.headline: Mistral releases Mistral Medium 3
items.summary: Mistral Medium 3 is a proprietary enterprise model priced at $0.40/$2 per million input/output tokens, deployable in hybrid, on-premises or VPC setups. Mistral claims it performs at or above 90% of Claude Sonnet 3.7 across benchmarks, with strengths in coding and STEM.
